title: Share
loading: One moment, the link is opening
lockedText: This link is protected with a password. Whoever shared it surely sent it along.
wrongPassword: The password is not right. Please take another close look.
tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait {n} minutes and try again.
expiredText: This link was good until a certain day, and that day has passed. Best ask whoever sent it to you for a new one.
usedUpText: This link could be downloaded only a few times, and all downloads are taken. Whoever shared it will surely send you a new one.
withdrawnText: This link does not exist any more. Feel free to ask whoever sent it to you.
missingText: There is nothing at this address. Maybe a character went astray while typing?
busyText: There were a lot of tries from here just now. Please wait a few minutes, then reload the page.
brokenText: The server does not answer at the moment. Please try again in a moment.
noPreview: There is no preview for this file. Downloading works, of course.
name: Name
uploadText: Drag files here or pick them. They land in the folder you are looking at.
tooBig: {name} no longer fits into the room this link offers.
noSpace: The server lacks the space for {name}.
tooManyUploads: Too many uploads are running. Please try {name} again in a moment.
uploadFailed: {name} did not arrive. Please try again.
noUploads: This link takes no more files.
